entry_points.text: Named node adjustment helpers serve as callable entries with low level form for callers managing interrupt state and outer saving form for general callers.

exports.text: Node adjustment offers two outer shapes plus a low level variant; per cpu differentials accumulate locally shifting byte items from page multiples, flushing bulk on threshold breach, using compare exchange with preemption control and interrupt protection in one shape.
Object cgroup uncharge with disable query, per cpu leak ignore and executable mapping are shared across files; uncharge forwards size to per processor stock refill with uncharge allowed.

Profiling exposes early registration, page extension ops, callback type and allocation wrapper; NUMA exposes off flag, masks with safe substitutes, cpu add, remove and clear, clamped early mapping, percpu offsets and distance, node count derived with oversize abort, and emulation string.

Virtual and physical boot release, physical leak hooks and unprofiled slab allocation are exposed; release ignores null, notifies leak tracking, edits reserved only before slab is usable or when retained, and releases pages only after.

hazards.text: Pressure sourced slabs are barred from per cpu sheaf caching with NUMA locality barring and defined memoryless exceptions.

Bulk free validates health, counts, pointer validity, membership, redzones and ownership withholding batches on failure; mismatched cache warns once and aborts; errors honor a test hook with tracing and state specific poisoning.
Tracker creation initializes links, lock, count to one, identities by interrupt or process context and backtrace handle.

invariants.text: Slab capacity scales page size by order over object size with repair on walk mismatch and frozen rejection; chunk offsets use power of two blocks with reversible conversions and bitmap sizing from pages; frees expand resetting interior blocks, recounting edges, adjusting empty pages and maintaining best runs.

One build never reclaims; the other exempts first and reserved and selects isolated with empty pages or surplus plus quarter empty; pointer conversion is base relative or identity with range checked lookup before page mapping, tolerating unguarded cpu reads as any unit yields the same chunk.
Invalid releases with unset marks return zero; valid ones clear ranges, grow free bytes, tighten hints, relocate and record deallocation.

Several helpers collapse by build to no operation or constants; balance queues only when async is enabled; deferred release holds preemption guard, normalizes tagging and appends at cache offset; tracking stores depot handle with caller, cpu, process and time.

Memcg release is idempotent scaling by possible cpus with overhead only when enabled; tag release subtracts only when profiling is active; ignoring acts only when enabled and valid with blackening disabling scanning; lookup holds read protection with table lock for search and object lock for painting.
Compressed profiling disables per page tagging need; cpu to node starts unassigned with membership ignoring unassigned.
Node allocation runs pre hook, debug short circuit, strict normalization, per cpu attempt then slow path with sanitized free pointer handling and post hook that may null the result.
Module tag backing starts as reserved aligned range and grows by appending bulk pages with shadow extension and unpoison, releasing new pages on failure; empty variants exist without the feature.

locks.text: Tracker pool and tree use an irq saving raw spinlock across freelist and linkage with spares handled outside; supply prefers slab cache then freelist then reserve, warning once on exhaustion and disabling tracking.

state_machines.text: Partial and full membership changes require the node list lock; a slab gaining its first free object leaves full for the partial tail, staying partial unless empty above quota when unlinked with counters decremented.

Chunks live in slots by largest free extent with exhausted in slot zero and whole units in a free slot, relocating after free unless isolated; isolated move once to depopulation with empty pages subtracted and reserved never moves; hints rebuild via fast promotion or full restart.

Module tag storage moves through reserved, padding, active, unloaded retained and free with aligned gap search and growth; map operations hold the exclusive lock; bad alignment or overflow shuts down with diagnostic and unwinds counters.

Early collection grows by prepending nodes when missing or full, retires by nulling the pointer with grace wait, drains numbers preserving valid tags and resetting others, then frees pools; unallocatable nodes drop frames with warning and validity race is tolerated.

Slow path preserves caller flags across constrained this node trial then full trial seeking partials first, cycling partial, new slab, downgraded, spinning or failure with counting; embed reserves groups, checks span with fallback on excess, copies static data, publishes chunk and halts on total percpu failure.

Profiling moves from unsupported to supported with independent enable and compression switches; boot handler parses modes, late init registers sysctls, proc report and tag type with unwind on failure, runtime toggle gates by support and debug state.

structs.text: Slab flag word carries pressure sourcing and node partial bits tested and mutated individually.
Page size and shift with block words, minimum allocation size, slot base shift and empty watermark parameterize capacity, bitmaps, slot choice and reclaim.

Early tracking node is a singly linked fixed capacity record sized as page minus header over one number; sysctl modes, boot keywords and NUMA log prefix are fixed ABI; NUMA early handler sets off flag or forwards emulation string.
